## Course overview

-   **Acquisition of Practical Bioinformatics Analysis Skills**

    ✅ What is RNA-seq data and how to analyze them

    ✅ Understanding fundamental statistics

    ✅ How to interpret and visualize the results

-   **Enhanced Data Convergence Capability for Translational Research**

    ✅ How to link omics data to clinical data

    ✅ How to explore public data of interest

    ✅ What would be promising targets

## Syllabus

| week | Contents                                    |
|------|---------------------------------------------|
| W1   | Introduction to Bioinformatics & R Setup    |
| W2   | R Fundamentals: Data Structures & Packages  |
| W3   | Data Wrangling & Visualization (dplyr)      |
| W4   | Public Database Exploration (GEO & TCGA)    |
| W5   | Pre-processing of RNA-seq Data              |
| W6   | Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)             |
| W7   | Differential Expression Gene (DEG) Analysis |
| W8   | (mid-term)                                  |
| W9   | DEG Results Processing                      |
| W10  | Over-representation analysis                |
| W11  | Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA)         |
| W12  | Rscript and vibe coding tips                |
| W13  | Summary and Wrap-up                         |

-   Part1: Intro and R Basics (W1-W4)
-   Part2: DEG analysis (W5-W7)
-   Part3: Result interpretation (W9-W11)
-   Part4: Practice and wrap-up (W12-W14)
